about: Which page, if any, states each sentence of a research answer (item 028). The pages are the frozen ones in tests/fixtures/research_benchmark.json ('source' is the index of the result in that case, null when no page states the sentence, 'meta' for a sentence about the sources or the answer itself rather than about the world). Written on 2026-11-24 before the code that maps sentences existed. dev: every sentence of the twelve chat answers the real model wrote in docs/benchmarks/research_dolphin3-8b.json (the app's own notes left out), and twelve sentences written to be unsupported, several of them hard on purpose (the right words with a changed number, a negation, a wrong 'current'). heldout: twelve sentences written to state what a page says in other words, and ten more unsupported ones of a different kind; measured once, after the code was written, and not used to change it.

dev.text: The latest stable release of Tidewater is version 4.2, published on 3 March 2026.
The previous release, 4.1, came out in October 2025 and remains supported until 2027.
